name: sheetview-orbit
label: Real data render
alt: The hosted Neuroglancer viewer, black background, with one mesh layer named sheet: a piece of papyrus sheet about 7 by 10 mm, shaded with the CT values on its surface, gray with dark patches and fine horizontal fibers. The camera swings slowly left and right and tips a little, so the sheet's gentle bends show as it turns.
caption: Real data render: kit sheetview turns PHerc0139 segment w045 (a 150 by 200 node crop of its tifxyz mesh) into a Neuroglancer mesh with the 2.399 um CT sampled onto each vertex (mean over plus or minus 4 voxels along the normal, level 1), shown in the hosted viewer. CT and mesh geometry, no labels, no ink. Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0.

data.credit: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0

command: python -m kit sheetview build s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data/PHerc0139/segments/20260126000000-w045_2026012619/mesh/20260126000000-on-20260102150214-2.399um.tifxyz --volume s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data/PHerc0139/volumes/20260102150214-2.399um-0.2m-78keV-masked.zarr --level 1 --crop 500 650 700 900 --upsample 2 --depth 4 --reduce mean --palette gray --out SHEET && python -m kit sheetview serve SHEET && python scripts/media/sheetview_media.py actions SHEET/state.json --out-dir PLAN --frames 40 && python scripts/media/capture_web.py "$(cat PLAN/url.txt)" --webgl --out-dir FRAMES --actions PLAN/orbit.json --width 960 --height 540 && python scripts/media/encode.py FRAMES --gif docs/assets/sheetview/sheetview-orbit.gif --fps 10 --gif-fps 10 --meta scripts/media/captures/sheetview-orbit.meta.json
